claim: SIA reported that U.S.-headquartered semiconductor companies had sales of US$425 billion in 2025, 53.4% of global sales and the highest U.S. share since 1984.
evidence: "The U.S. industry reached sales of $425 billion in 2025, representing 53.4% of total global sales and the highest U.S. market share since 1984." Chart "GLOBAL MARKET SHARE BY COMPANY HQ, 2025", "Source: WSTS, Gartner, Omdia, and SIA estimates" (SIA 2026 State of the U.S. Semiconductor Industry, p.7)

metric.name: U.S.-headquartered companies' share of global semiconductor sales
metric.population: Semiconductor sales of U.S.-headquartered companies / world semiconductor market
metric.methodology: SIA estimate from WSTS, Gartner and Omdia data, attributed by company headquarters

notes: Newer-year companion to CLM-0076 (CY2024: US$318bn, 50.4%). Found by fact-check fc-W0-546c.

claim: SIA's 2026 State of the Industry report puts 2025 global semiconductor sales at US$795.6 billion, replacing the US$791.7 billion it first reported in February 2026.
evidence: "Global semiconductor sales reached $795.6 billion in 2025, far exceeding initial forecasts and setting a record for the industry." (SIA 2026 SOTI, p.6); earlier: "global semiconductor sales hit $791.7 billion in 2025" (SIA, 6 Feb 2026)

metric.name: Global semiconductor sales
metric.population: WSTS-compiled world semiconductor sales as reported by SIA

notes: Fact-check correction of CLM-0049. Same as the WSTS Spring 2026 table (CLM-0030).

claim: SIA's 2026 State of the Industry report gives 2025 logic sales of US$299.5 billion (+38.8%) and memory sales of US$230.0 billion (+39.0%), replacing the US$301.9 billion and US$223.1 billion it first reported in February 2026.
evidence: "Sales of logic chips totaled $299.5 billion in 2025, increasing by 38.8% year-on-year, making it the largest semiconductor product category by sales. Memory products were second in sales at $230.0 billion in 2025, a 39.0% sales increase over 2024." (SIA 2026 SOTI, p.6)

metric.name: Logic sales
metric.population: WSTS logic category as reported by SIA

notes: Fact-check correction of CLM-0050. Memory in the same sentence: 230.0 USD bn (+39.0%). Matches the WSTS Spring 2026 table (CLM-0035, CLM-0036).

claim: Gartner's latest published figure (August 2026) for 2025 worldwide semiconductor revenue is US$809.0 billion, revised up from its preliminary US$793.4 billion (January 2026) and US$805.3 billion (April 2026).
evidence: "Global semiconductor revenue is expected to reach $1.6 trillion in 2026, increasing 92% from 2025 revenue of $809 billion"; Table 1 "Total Market 809.0" (Gartner, 24 Aug 2026); "Total Market 805.3" (Gartner, 8 Apr 2026, Table 1); "Total Market 793,449" (Gartner, 12 Jan 2026, Table 1)

metric.name: Worldwide semiconductor revenue
metric.methodology: Gartner vendor revenue analysis; method not disclosed in release
